dedupe_keys.name: districts hit tropical cyclone 8 event data sets igad climate prediction and applications center on hdx

description: Districts hit Tropical Cyclone (8 event data sets, IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). Tropical Cyclone 1A became the first documented tropical cyclone to move through the Gulf of Aden. The tropical storm struck about 65 km (40 mi) west of Berbera District, Somalia and quickly dissipated. TC1A had a windspeed of 23m/s before dissipating. Coverage: Somalia. The portal lists 8 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). Its tags are geodata, hazards and risk. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
